# Sekiro Mod Manager - Electron.js Project

## Project Overview
An Electron.js application for managing Sekiro mods with upload, activation, and extraction features.

## Features
- Upload mods from zip files
- Store mods in %LOCALAPPDATA%/Sekiro/mods
- Display mod list with activation toggle
- Extract activated mods to game directory

## Development
- Framework: Electron.js
- Storage: Local filesystem (%LOCALAPPDATA%)
- Mod format: ZIP files
